applicability: The scheduler advances to the first recurrence strictly after the completed occurrence.
law: Completing a single-weekday occurrence advances to the same weekday the following week.

input_strategy.action: Complete the starting occurrence and ask for the next one.

edge_cases: A cutoff exactly at the completed occurrence.

oracle.derivation: RFC 5545 weekly-until example starts September 2 and lists September 9 as the next occurrence.

known_wrong_implementations: Advance to the next day by comparing weekday without week.
